evals.prompt: I need to collect product data from several shop websites I haven't picked yet, and then find stock photos plus design-inspiration images from the web for my app. Which MCP tools should I use for each task? Give me the specific tool names. Use the mcp-patterns skill.
evals.expected_output: firecrawl_agent for structured data from sites whose URLs are not known, firecrawl_scrape with formats json and jsonOptions for one known URL, Jina search_images with return_url true for web images, the Pexels REST API /v1/search for stock photos.
expectations: The answer recommends firecrawl_agent for structured data from sites whose URLs are not known yet
The answer recommends firecrawl_scrape with formats json and jsonOptions for extracting structured data from one URL
The answer names search_images for the design-inspiration images from the web
The answer says to pass return_url true to search_images
The answer names the Pexels REST API /v1/search for stock photos
